title: Recovery path may fail under relevant conditions
cause: The actual identity-provider failure scenario and recovery access have not been demonstrated
event: The recovery path does not work when the pilot needs secure restoration
effect: Administrators cannot restore service within the acceptance boundary
evidence: No executed applicable demonstration is supplied
preventive_response: Define the failure scenario and expected audit behavior, then execute an applicable recovery demonstration
owner: Technical performer to confirm; Mina coordinates
trigger: The demonstration fails, cannot be scheduled or does not cover the agreed conditions
contingency: Keep readiness open, investigate and correct, retest, then reassess the date through decision control
note: The imagined outage is a hypothesis, not an observed incident.
decision_boundary: Whether recovery and operator evidence support the pilot readiness commitment

title: Operators may not use recovery guidance successfully
cause: Operator access and walkthrough evidence are absent
event: Support cannot complete the required recovery steps
effect: Disruption extends and service restoration remains unverified
existing_control: Support guidance exists in draft form
evidence: No representative operator validation is supplied
preventive_response: Run an operator walkthrough against the actual configuration and capture usability and access findings
owner: Service role and technical performer to confirm
trigger: An operator cannot access, understand or complete a required step
contingency: Revise guidance and access, repeat the walkthrough and retain readiness evidence
note: A technical recovery test alone does not prove operator usability.
decision_boundary: Whether recovery and operator evidence support the pilot readiness commitment
